about: Mock matching v2 test vectors (GraphQL operation condition), generated from the reference functions in packages/protocol/src/index.ts. Requests: { method, url, appId?, contentType?, body? }; a large body is given as bodyPattern instead: [text, times] pairs, body = each text repeated times, joined in order. Body lengths count UTF-16 code units. operations[].expected is graphqlOperationsOf(request): a list of { name?, type? } or null (unknown). matches[].expected is mockRuleMatchesRequest(rule, request); matchesNoBody is mockRuleMatches(rule, method, url, appId) (the old signature, no body). finds[].expectedId is findMockRuleForRequest(rules, request)?.id.

operations.description: operationName wins, type from the named operation
no operationName: first operation of the document

request.body: {"query":"query GetFeed { feed { id } } query Other { x }"}
{"operationName":"B","query":"query A { a } mutation B { b } subscription C { c }"}

operations.description: operationName not in the document: name only, type unknown

request.body: {"query":"fragment F on User { id } query WithFragment { me { ...F } }"}

operations.description: comments, strings and block strings are skipped

request.body: {"query":"# query Fake { x }\n\"\"\"block query Fake2 { y }\"\"\" query Real(arg: \"query Nope\") { z }"}

operations.description: words inside selections are not operations
query that is not a string
batched array: one operation per element

request.body: query FromDoc { a } mutation Second { b }

operations.description: JSON detected by the first character whatever the content type
whitespace-only body counts as no body (POST)
multi-byte UTF-8 at the bound (UTF-16 length counts)
astral chars (two UTF-16 units each) one over the bound
astral chars at the bound (fewer characters than units)
trailing spaces push the untrimmed body over the bound
GET fragment part is not the query string
GET with a body uses the body
POST does not read URL parameters
JSON: number with a leading zero is invalid
JSON: number ending in a dot is invalid
JSON: number with an empty exponent is invalid
JSON: a plus sign before a number is invalid
JSON: a huge exponent is valid
JSON: a raw tab inside a string is invalid
JSON: an unknown escape is invalid
JSON: a short unicode escape is invalid
JSON: escapes in keys and values are decoded
JSON: a lone surrogate escape is valid
JSON: the last duplicate key wins
JSON: a duplicate key may drop the name
JSON: unterminated deep nesting is invalid
JSON: non-ASCII operation names are kept
batched array: nested arrays are not payloads

request.body: Query Upper { a } query Lower { b }

operations.description: GET literal non-ASCII characters are kept
GET an encoded surrogate is undecodable
GET a truncated sequence is undecodable
GET an undecodable pair elsewhere makes all unknown
GET a name without = is empty
